question: Should `talk.idleTimeoutS` apply to every macOS Talk session or only sessions started through Voice Wake?
rationale: The linked issue is Voice Wake-specific, while the proposed durable config intentionally governs every opted-in macOS Talk session; repository source cannot determine which product contract maintainers want.

options.title: Keep general opt-in
options.body: Support idle auto-deactivation for every macOS Talk session when explicitly configured, avoiding new activation-source state while preserving existing behavior by default.

options.title: Narrow to Voice Wake
options.body: Track the activation source and expire only Voice Wake-started sessions, preserving configured manually started Talk sessions until explicit stop.

recommendation.title: Keep general opt-in
recommendation.body: Support idle auto-deactivation for every macOS Talk session when explicitly configured, avoiding new activation-source state while preserving existing behavior by default.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest sustained feature-history signal covers Talk runtime, config, and Gateway contract behavior.
